#
## TIAFM (I can't think of any other name) is a mod that adds various type of furnitures with vanilla styles!
## Featuring around 344 blocks: Survival friendly (craftable blocks), various types of new wooden walls (wood panel), functional block (such as container blocks, display blocks, animated blocks, sittable blocks and connectable blocks and vanilla styles!
